g.title: architecture
g.text: Decentralised edge robot (PuppyPi), integrated with the centralized layer

g.title: orchestrator
g.text: allocates tasks to robots, sequences steps

g.title: shell
g.text: runs the chosen primitive via ROS

g.title: skills
g.text: open · close · push · grab · putinto · puton

g.title: driver
g.text: later: real PuppyPi ROS driver, same topics

g.title: legend
g.text: other robots in the fleet (not this repo)

g.title: note
g.text: Per step: the shell asks SmolVLM for the next primitive, runs it,
feeds back the new image and outcome, and repeats until SmolVLM
calls report(...) or a safety limit trips (then: failed / blocked).
Steps arrive one at a time, once their depends_on steps are done.
All edge nodes run with use_sim_time:=true (/clock from Isaac Sim).
